Done by waiting: keep Cerberus above 400 hitpoints until its 14th attack begins. The souls only come on its 7th, 14th and 28th attacks, and only below 400, so after the 14th there are none until the 28th.
It counted with Verac's flail alone on both of her forms and no special attack; a thrall fighting alongside did not spoil it.
A hit that landed on the tick his gas began did not spoil the task. Thralls do not spoil it either.

An untradeable item made from other items counts at the price of what it is made from, not at its own low value: with an Amulet of blood fury (Amulet of fury and a Blood shard) and Ferocious gloves (Hydra leather) on, the set came to 23M and the kill did not count. Plain untradeables such as a Fighter torso or Barrows gloves count little.\nTo see the figure the game uses, open Items Kept on Death and turn on "PK Skull active": the total has to be under 2,000,000. Runes inside a rune pouch did not change that total.
